At \`2026-07-28T06:04:16\` task \`ajc-etale-pic\` was set \`running\` -> \`done\`. In the same instant, all four rows in its \`roadmap_refs\` were rewritten:

\`I-0386\`'s mitigation is a discipline: read \`roadmap_refs\` before a terminal status, then re-assert each row's status afterwards. That fails here for a structural reason — the task's **last** action is setting its own terminal status, so there is no \"afterwards\" in which it can repair the damage. 3. **At minimum, name what changed in the command output**, so the next reader can see four rows moved and object.
